response.text: {"summary":"The tpl_tcp_server_client repository implements a simple TCP chat system using only the standard library. The `client.py::main` function reads lines from stdin, sends them to the server, and prints any incoming messages, while `protocol.py::MAX_LINE` defines the maximum allowed line length for the UTF‑8, newline‑terminated wire format. The `server.py::handle_client` routine runs each connection in its own thread, broadcasting each received message to all other connected clients. Together, the protocol module defines the message format, the client module provides the user interface, and the server module manages multi‑client communication."}
